method: Five alternating fresh-process pairs; serial executor; VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1; automatic dispatch; one warmup and median of three calls with full GC before each. Decode overwrites a prepared prefix; generation resets the session. Pinned model SHA256 and four greedy token IDs checked for every prompt/variant. Independent ASDF caches; matching Release builds; CPU load guard before/after each process and at output boundaries after 60 seconds.
